name: The Fate of Ramaladni
label: Quest
description: The Fate of Ramaladni: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood - a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Dawn even existed! When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over.

Understand this, friend, when rage and retribution take the reins, a man ceases to be a man. The man personifies the emotions that control him instead. And so it would be that Ramaladni, the spirit of retribution, would enter Naxxramas to exact vengeance... And never return.
Enter Naxxramas and find what became of Ramaladni.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is his ring! But it is destroyed. No other evidence of Ramaladni was found?
This does not bode well for Ramaladni. The ring, however... It might be salvageable.
